notes.title: Update ver.1.1.0
notes.notes:
The following updates have been implemented:

Changes:
1.Fixed typos (Japanese and Simplified Chinese).
2.Fixed an issue where skipping could not be canceled in some scenes.
3.Fixed an issue where save data would get corrupted (unable to load) when saving in certain scenes.
*If your save data has already been corrupted, we sincerely apologize, and kindly ask you to use a different save file.

Please use the update feature to apply the changes.
We apologize for the inconvenience and the time it took to correct the problem.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
We have fixed a bug that prevented some illustrations
from being displayed in the Gallery in English and Simplified Chinese.
Please use the update function.

We apologize for any concerns.
